notes:
BUILD 19  -  THE RAID UPDATE
- OIL RIG out at sea (on the map): a stepped pier from the waterline up to the deck, heavy scientists, auto turrets, and locked crates in the crew quarters.
- BUNKER dug in under rock on land: a blast door only explosives will open (two rockets), then turrets, heavies and three vaults of locked crates.
- Heavy scientists: black suits, twice the health, hit harder.
- Locked crates: E starts a 50 second lock and calls reinforcements. Best loot in the game (AK, LR-300, M249, launcher, rockets, HQM, armour) plus fuel.
- Reinforcements: a patrol helicopter gunship comes when you kill a heavy, drop a blast door or work a lock; at the rig a scientist gunboat circles too. Both can be shot down; the gunship drops two open elite crates where it falls on land.
- The patrol helicopter also turns up on its own every half hour or so.
- Minicopter gun mode (F): you can now look around and aim; the key is in the minicopter's control line.
- Bullets lose damage with distance: pistol rounds from 20 m, rifle rounds from 60 m.
